cards.question: `window.scrollY`
cards.answer: Position of the top of the layout viewport in document coordinates.

cards.question: `window.scrollX`
cards.answer: Position of the left of the layout viewport in document coordinates.

cards.question: `getBoundingClientRect()`
cards.answer: Viewport-relative coordinates of the smallest rectangle containing the element's border box(es).

cards.question: Viewport coordinates in terms of document coordinates
Document coordinates in terms of viewport coordinates
`window.innerWidth` and `window.innerHeight`
cards.answer: Width and height of the layout viewport, including scrollbars.

cards.question: `window.outerWidth` and `window.outerHeight`
cards.answer: Width and height of the browser window, including toolbars, etc. (browser chrome).
